text:
zara-finance: Heads-up: Vendor Montclair Labs (vendor_id ML-607) submitted INV-MT-601 dated 2025-09-18 charging 15% VAT and a 5% "withholding gross-up" line. PO 7011 is for Redwood Ltd (GB). Can we triage?
omar-procurement: Invoice addressed to which entity?
zara-finance: Invoice to Redwood, Inc (US) but PO was created under Redwood Ltd (GB). Snippet:
```INV-MT-601
Vendor: Montclair Labs Ltd (IE)
VAT: IE98765432
Service: Model tuning (Aug-Sep 2025) 50h @ EUR120 = 6,000EUR
Gross-up (withholding) +300EUR
VAT 15% = 945EUR
Total = 7,245EUR```
ruth-legal: Two quick items: 1) If billed to UK entity, reverse charge might apply (remove VAT) — request reissue to Redwood Ltd with our GB VAT. 2) Gross-up must be contractually agreed; check SOW and any amendments.
tax-bot: Automated check: Vendor country=IE (Ireland). PO shows Redwood Ltd VAT GB987654321. No W-8/W-9 on file. Note: Irish VAT on B2B services to a UK VAT-registered customer typically subject to reverse charge. Gross-up flagged as non-standard.
zara-finance: AP put INV-MT-601 ON_HOLD in Coupa. :no_entry_sign:
omar-procurement: Reached out to vendor asking for: reissued invoice to Redwood Ltd (GB987654321), explanation for 15% VAT (are they applying reduced rate?), removal of gross-up unless they provide signed amendment, and any tax vouchers if they intend to withhold. Also requested copy of Irish charity/co-op status if relevant.
vendor-montclair: (vendor reply) "We billed the US entity by mistake. We added gross-up because our local payroll agency told us there may be a 5% payroll levy when invoices are processed. We'll reissue to Redwood Ltd and remove VAT and gross-up unless you require otherwise"
zara-finance: Thanks. AP leaving on hold until corrected invoice + proof from vendor if withholding actually occurred.
ap-bot: Invoice INV-MT-601 status updated -> ON_HOLD at 2025-09-19T09:05:00Z by zara-finance.
ruth-legal: Add to reply: please provide the payroll agency note if they still claim levy so legal can assess. If they insist on gross-up, escalate to procurement for commercial decision. Keep full audit trail (original + reissue + correspondence).
zara-finance: Draft sent to vendor 2025-09-19 09:10 BST. Will update when reissue arrives.
tax-bot: Reminder: If vendor actually withholds any amount later, obtain an official tax certificate/voucher with withholding rate and gross/net amounts for our records and possible relief.
omar-procurement: Noted. Closing thread when reissue uploaded to vendor portal.
